patthana18.1:3.1: hetuṃ sahetukañca na hetuṃ sahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana18.1:4.1: hetuyā tīṇi ārammaṇe ekaṃ avigate pañca.
patthana18.1:5.1: nahetuṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā:.
patthana18.1:6.1: nahetuyā ekaṃ naārammaṇe tīṇi novigate tīṇi.
patthana18.1:8.1: hetu sahetuko dhammo na hetussa na sahetukassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:.

patthana18.1:10.1: nahetu sahetuko dhammo na nahetussa na sahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: nahetu sahetuko dhammo na hetussa na sahetukassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: nahetu sahetuko dhammo na hetussa na sahetukassa ca na nahetussa na sahetukassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana18.1:12.1: hetuyā ekaṃ ārammaṇe cha adhipatiyā dve avigate pañca. pañhāvāraṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.
patthana18.1:13.1: hetuṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. nahetuṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu
patthana18.1:14.1: na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
